summary: Frontend-only end-to-end testing of the new Project Settings screen on HALL at desktop 1920x1000. Verified Home -> prompt send -> Workspace -> Configurações flow, breadcrumb/header, Save/Discard dirty-state behavior across Overview and other sections, all 10 sidebar nav items (overview/models/github/integrations/security/design/deploy/environment/logs/advanced), Models & Agents selects + toggles (4 agents), Security toggles (5), Environment variables rendering with masked values + Adicionar button, Logs search + level + source filtering, Advanced Danger Zone confirmation dialogs (archive/reset/delete) + toast + no-navigation, and Abrir projeto returning to the workspace keeping context. All 13 testable criteria PASS.

issues: Edit (pencil) and Delete (trash) actions on env-var rows are icon-only buttons without visible text 'Editar'/'Excluir'. Visually clear but reduces discoverability; consider aria-labels or tooltips (they do render as required by the task).
When Home prompt is longer than ~12 chars, project name used for breadcrumb/header is truncated (e.g. 'Build a todo app' -> 'Build a todo'). Minor UX nit; may be intentional slicing from the prompt.

verification_details.home_to_workspace: textarea fill + button[aria-label='Enviar prompt'] click opens workspace (ws-settings-btn visible).
verification_details.workspace_to_settings: ws-settings-btn click opens project-settings; breadcrumb 'Projetos › <project> › Configurações' confirmed.
verification_details.header: Avatar initial, project name, 'Projeto' badge and subtitle all render.
verification_details.save_discard_initial_disabled: save-btn and discard-btn disabled on first render (both true).
verification_details.edit_enables_save: After editing overview-name, both buttons become enabled.
verification_details.discard_restores_and_disables: Clicking Descartar restores original name and re-disables both buttons.
verification_details.save_persists_and_disables: Clicking Salvar alterações keeps new value and disables buttons.
verification_details.sidebar_nav: All 10 settings-nav-* items click and swap content without reload. Active item has 'active' class, no solid red square (background rgba(255,255,255,0.04)); red indicator rendered as separate element (visible in screenshots).
verification_details.models: 4 agent cards present (coding/design/security/review) each with models-select-* and models-toggle-*; toggling enables Save.
verification_details.security: All 5 toggles (deps/env/deploy/confirm/scan) present and clicking enables Save.
verification_details.environment: 3 env-var rows render with masked '••••' values + 'Adicionar variável' button. Row-level edit/delete are icon buttons.
verification_details.logs: 5 initial log rows. Search 'xyznoop_match' -> 0 rows; level filter idx1 -> 3 rows; source filter idx1 -> 2 rows (filters work).
verification_details.advanced_danger_zone: danger-archive/reset/delete each open confirm-dialog, confirmation triggers a toast, user stays in settings (no navigation, no deletion).
verification_details.open_project: Abrir projeto returns to workspace with ws-settings-btn visible (context preserved).

critical_code_review_comments: All data-testid hooks required by the task are present and selectable; dirty-state detection via JSON compare works for text, select and toggle changes.
Minor: project name derived from the Home prompt is sliced/truncated (~12 chars). If this is unintended, trim and allow full name instead of a prefix slice.
Minor: env-var row edit/delete icon buttons should have accessible labels (aria-label) for a11y.
seed_data_creation: none - frontend-only mock data used by the feature.
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is Vite + React + TS with state-based routing (no URL changes). Public URL: https://hall-space-1.preview.emergentagent.com. There is no /app/frontend/.env file; the frontend is served by `yarn start` on port 3000 via supervisor. To reach Project Settings: fill the first textarea on Home -> click button[aria-label='Enviar prompt'] -> on workspace click [data-testid='ws-settings-btn']. All settings data is mocked in components/settings/data.ts; Save/Discard uses JSON compare for dirty state. No backend calls are made from Settings.
